# hookbase_destination (Data Source)

Look up an existing Hookbase destination by ID or slug.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Destination ID.
- `slug` (String) Destination slug.

### Read-Only

- `auth_type` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `has_signing_secret` (Boolean) Whether the destination signs its deliveries (true for http destinations). The secret itself is not exposed by the data source.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `method` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `timeout_ms` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `use_static_ip` (Boolean)
